summary: Read DataView buffer, byteOffset, and byteLength with out-of-bounds checks.

semantics.byteOffset: throws TypeError if view is out of bounds
semantics.byteLength: dynamic for length-tracking views; throws TypeError if out of bounds

tests.name: metadata
tests.input: const b=new ArrayBuffer(8); const v=new DataView(b,2,3); console.log(v.buffer===b,v.byteOffset,v.byteLength);

tests.name: tracking length
tests.input: const b=new ArrayBuffer(4,{maxByteLength:8}); const v=new DataView(b,1); b.resize(6); console.log(v.byteLength);
